mapper.select: select id, file_name, file_type, file_size, parse_status, created_at from resume where user_id = #{userId} order by id desc
mapper.insert: insert into resume (user_id, file_name, file_type, file_size, raw_text) values (#{userId}, #{fileName}, #{fileType}, #{fileSize}, #{rawText})
mapper.update: update resume set summary_text = #{summary}, parse_status = #{status}, parsed_at = now(3) where id = #{id}
